objective: Validate mechanical load estimates before coupling fatigue, metabolic or strategy predictions.

validation_sequence.purpose: Check implementation, units and force/moment closure; not human force accuracy.
Match mass, posture, load point and COP to measured data; independently check moment arms and passive references.
Replay synchronized experimental kinematics, GRF and COP; do not treat a designed controller trajectory as measured input.
Compare the same tissue-force observable and joint-reaction definition, with force-time phase, peak, impulse, uncertainty and parameter sensitivity. Publish missing tissues and unresolved sharing.
Only after replay validation, predict new body proportions, motion or barbell conditions within a stated range, and verify solved contact and conservation.
Add separately calibrated state models; keep their validation distinct from mechanics.

joint_fatigue: reference joint capacity and its provenance
muscle_metabolic_energy: fiber-type reference and declared metabolic model
oxidation: define whether oxygen/ATP oxidative metabolism or oxidative stress is intended
calibrated state equations and suitable experimental observables; do not infer directly from tendon tension
